{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter out rows where customer_age == -1 (sentinel for missing age)
valid_ages = sales[sales['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age
mean_age = valid_ages.mean()

# Also compute the count of valid ages
count_valid_ages = len(valid_ages)

# Print both values
print(f'Mean age of customers with valid age: {mean_age}')
print(f'Number of customers with valid age: {count_valid_ages}')"}
